title: Production passive checks not run: sandbox network policy blocks the hosts
unverified_reason: The cloud environment's network policy rejects CONNECT to nodbusiness.vercel.app and nodbusiness-backend-9psf.onrender.com (proxy 403). Owner can allow these hosts in the environment's Network access settings.
expected: Production headers, TLS configuration, robots/sitemap/security.txt, email DNS (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) and one Lighthouse run checked read-only.
actual: Not checked. Repository config suggests: backend HSTS + deny-all CSP in production; frontend CSP as in F-016; HSTS on the frontend depends on Vercel.
impact: Hosting-layer settings (Vercel/Render headers, TLS, DNS) are unknown.
fix: Allow the two hosts, then re-run the passive checks.
